text: 2026-11-17 [[example-apps-notes-v2-plus-note_viewer]]: steps 1 and 2 of 4 are on bleeding. A 3-expert panel agreed a rule for who counts as the same person in a peer; asks 13 to 16 there need you. It fixes a hole in step 2, where a reused connection name can match the wrong person, so peers stay off main until it is built. Ask 16 is a new step: the identity service as a sign-in provider for apps. 0.5.2 waits for PR 13 (held).
